# Digital Bridge Academy

> Patient, human-first computer classes for adults and seniors in the Portland, OR metro area, online and onsite — everyday tech confidence, online safety and scam defense, job-ready computer skills, and AI for beginners. Six learners at most per class, plain language, no jargon. Free intro workshop every Saturday and free consultations.

Run by Steven J. Hubbard (Steven J Hubbard LLC). Contact: contact@digital-bridge-academy.com, (415) 359-7606.

## Courses

- [Everyday Tech Confidence](https://www.digital-bridge-academy.com/courses/everyday-tech.html): Smartphone basics, email, video calls, online banking, telehealth — 6 weeks, small groups.
- [Online Safety & Scam Defense](https://www.digital-bridge-academy.com/courses/online-safety.html): Spot phishing, phone scams, and fraud; password security, two-factor, privacy settings.
- [Job-Ready Computer Skills](https://www.digital-bridge-academy.com/courses/job-ready.html): Microsoft Office and Google Workspace basics, professional email, resume writing, job applications.
- [AI for Everyone](https://www.digital-bridge-academy.com/ai.html): Use AI assistants for email, resumes, research, and everyday tasks — no programming required.

## Getting started

- [Home](https://www.digital-bridge-academy.com/): Overview, digital confidence quiz, FAQ, and booking.
- Free intro workshop every Saturday; book a consultation via the contact form on the homepage.
